players.product: Inference-first GPU-as-a-Service cloud on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs deployed in colocation sites; NVIDIA Cloud Partner

quarterly_data.quarter: QumulusAI press release: QumulusAI Completes B200 Deployment Under Its $71.9 Million (09-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: QumulusAI completed deployment of NVIDIA B200 GPU capacity and handed it off to the customer, an AI inference platform provider (not named), under the $71.9 million, three-year agreement announced July 28, 2026; full handoff of the B200 portion was reached Sept. 8, 2026, and the NVIDIA B300 capacity under the same agreement is in its final stages of deployment. The company says the deployment ranks among its largest customer commitments to reach live production capacity to date. CEO Michael Maniscalco: 'The B200 capacity is live and serving our customer's inference workloads today, and the B300 portion is close behind.'
quarterly_data.figure: $71.9 million three-year agreement; B200 handoff Sept. 8, 2026; B300 portion in final stages of deployment
